shortBio.en: Sigur Rós vocalist and guitarist; falsetto and bowed-guitar texture.
shortBio.zh: Sigur Rós 主唱与吉他；假声与弓拉吉他织体。

body.en: Born 1975, Reykjavík (Jón Þór Birgisson). Lead vocals and guitar for Sigur Rós. Falsetto and bowed electric guitar mark much of the studio sound.
body.zh: 1975 年生于雷克雅未克（Jón Þór Birgisson）。Sigur Rós 主唱与吉他。假声与弓拉电吉他构成大量录音室音色。
